blockingIssues.problem: The description tells borrowers they can collect reserved tools “at any time during desk opening hours,” which contradicts the source statement that the pickup window printed on each confirmation still applies. That wording could mislead borrowers into attempting pickup outside their confirmed pickup window.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: Source: “The pickup window printed on each confirmation still applies.”
blockingIssues.constraint: The notice must preserve the source’s condition that borrowers follow the pickup window printed on their confirmation; it must not imply pickup is allowed at any time outside that window.
